# The Silent Sky's Faithful Witness

## Scripture
"Lift up your eyes and look to the heavens: Who created all these? He who brings out the starry host one by one and calls forth each of them by name. Because of his great power and mighty strength, not one of them is missing." — Isaiah 40:26 (NIV)

## Reflection
Tonight, step outside and look up. The stars you see have been traveling their appointed paths for millennia—unchanging, faithful, utterly reliable. But here's the wonder: they are not silent accidents. God calls each one by name, and not one is missing.

In a world of shifting opinions, broken promises, and restless hearts, the night sky whispers a quiet truth: God is a keeper of appointments. The same Word that held the stars in place since creation is the Word that holds your life together. When your circumstances feel chaotic, when your prayers seem to vanish into the dark, remember—the star you see tonight is proof that God has never once failed to show up.

The stars don't strive to shine. They simply remain where their Creator placed them, reflecting His glory without anxiety. What if we lived like that? Not frantic, not fearful, but faithfully present, trusting that the One who numbers the stars also numbers our days.

Your life may feel small against the vastness of the cosmos. But the same God who calls every star by name—He knows your name too. And He is not missing from your story.

## Prayer
Faithful Creator, thank You for the silent witness of the stars that declare Your steadfastness. Help me trust that the same power which holds the universe together is holding me. When I feel lost in the dark, remind me that You call me by name, and You never lose one of Your own. In Jesus' name, Amen.
